S1 E185Manmohan and Vibhuti express concern over Angoori's condition until Amma Ji provides a remedy. Later, the residents gather to celebrate Diwali.
S1 E186Manmohan fixes his radio and dances with Angoori, but her father Bhoorey Lal visits, hating Manmohan's choices. Later, Vibhuti offers Bhoorey Lal to stay, hoping to exploit his hatred.

S1 E615Lily attempts to get close to Vibhuti, who walks away from her in discomfort. Later, Anita and Angoori decide to teach their husbands a lesson when they continue to gamble despite their promises.
S1 E616Anita refuses to stop dancing at the casino until Vibhuti agrees to stop gambling. Meanwhile, Vibhuti lies that Anita is pregnant to prevent Angoori from leaving for the village with Ammaji.

S1 E617David interrupts Vibhuti and Anita to announce his upcoming wedding in London. Meanwhile, Tillu swindles money from Tiwari as terrorists prepare a dangerous plan to hijack the flight to the UK.
S1 E618Angoori expresses her desire to travel to London to Tiwari. Later, Tiwari discovers that Tillu has funded the plane tickets for Teeka and Malkhan to make their own trip to the city.
S1 E619The Mishras and Tiwaris board an aeroplane where terrorists hide a firearm. Meanwhile, an urgent stomach issue forces Happu to rush into the toilet with the weapon.

S1 E620A criminal draws a weapon and hijacks a flight, threatening the passengers and demanding a prisoner release. Meanwhile, the terrified hostages panic as the hijackers attempt to divert the aircraft.

Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In Naked and Afraid, complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

In Naked and Afraid, complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

p.t: Cecil: The Legacy Of A King
p.d: Cecil, a magnificent and massive lion, builds an impressive legacy as he sets off to be the protector of the lions in Hwange National Park.: While that rich American dentist and the hunting industry at large scramble for excuses and justifications for their actions, your rivals will already have killed your cubs and settled into your territory. Yes, those weak ones who could not challenge you now run your kingdom.

The filmmaker portrays the skills and techniques of some of the most wrathful, prideful and gluttonous predators who kill creatures that get in their way.: A look at the jaws, poison and powers of the nightmarish creatures lurking in the world's seas.

The filmmaker gives an insight into the wildlife of Africa and how they have evolved over time to survive and sustain themselves.: Africa is a land sculpted by time where animals have evolved complex weapons to arm them in the battle to live another day. An elephant's tusks can defend, or attack. An octopus uses camouflage to find food, or hide from an enemy. A Cape Fur Seal's speed and agility are valuable tools to catch a penguin, but ineffectual against a Great White Shark. A single hippopotamus holds a pride of twelve lions at bay with his sheer bulk, but backs down when faced with the piercing teeth of another hippo. W

The filmmaker explores the lives and survival tactics of one of the most complex predators, snakes, and also how they are useful for mankind.: The filmmaker presents the complex nature of snakes and sheds light on their role in maintaining the balance of nature and, therefore, human beings.

The filmmaker examines the conflict between animals, closely observing their frenzied state and exploring the underlying causes of such behaviour.: These two fascinating episodes from the Emmy Award-winning public television series Animals Gone Wild have filmmakers capturing on tape all creatures great and small in situations ranging from impressive to appalling, heartwarming to horrific. The host delves into the fascinating realm of mind-controlling parasites in the animal kingdom and explores how alien parasites and viruses make animals act like zombie slaves.: Alien Invaders: Naturalist Dan O'Neil explores the weird world of alien invaders, from Zombie moose to parasites that take over the eyestalks of snails. 7+. (1 of 2)
